Grade 9 Math · Solving Linear EquationsPart 2 of 4 · 20 min

Variables on Both Sides

Move every variable term to one side first, then solve as usual

KEY IDEA Do the same operation to both sides. Subtract the smaller variable term from both sides so the coefficient stays positive.
3x + 5 = x − 7  →  2x + 5 = −7  →  2x = −12  →  x = −6
1.Solve each equation. Show every step.
a)4x − 3 = 2x + 9
b)7 − 2x = 3x − 8
c)5(x − 2) = 3x + 4
d)x/2 + 3 = x − 1
2.A gym charges $36 to join plus $12 a month. Another charges $18 a month with no joining fee. After how many months do they cost the same? Write an equation and solve it.3 marks
